highlights: Baseus 12/12 Pro 2pcs Anti Blue Light Tempered Glass Screen Protector – SGAPIPH61P-KP01
This glass from Baseus is an impenetrable armor against harmful influences and environmental factors.

The accessory will protect the screen, as the most fragile part of the iPhone 12/12 Pro case, from minor mechanical damage: scratches, cracks and gaps, as well as the accumulation of dirt particles. If you put your phone in your pocket or bag, you don't have to worry about leaving marks on the screen after hitting your keys (or other hard object).
The thickness of Baseus glass is only 0.3 mm, and its texture is completely transparent. Being installed on the surface, the accessory remains invisible visually and physically imperceptible.
The original color rendering of the display is completely preserved without any distortion. Also, the presence of glass does not affect the touch response of the screen.
The oleophobic nanocoating of the glass eliminates the need for constant wiping of the surface of the accessory.
Fingerprints and stains simply do not remain on the glass, allowing you to keep a clean and tidy appearance of the device.
